proposal.summary: Authenticated Local File Inclusion (LFI) in the GLPI Activity plugin (versions before 3.1.0) allowing an authenticated user to read arbitrary files via the cra.send.php file parameter.

PR.quote: Authenticated Local File Inclusion (LFI) in the GLPI Activity plugin (versions before 3.1.0) allowing an authenticated user to read arbitrary files via the cra.send.php file parameter.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request full exploit details and authentication requirements from reporter or attempt to reproduce against an instrumented instance to capture which files can be read and whether administrative credentials are required.

evidence_quotes.claim: Exploit request demonstrating file path traversal and file parameter
